_about: Speakers of each FHB language worldwide — first AND second language (Kevin 2026-10-13: 'number of speakers/users of each language worldwide. People can have more than one edition.'). Languages with 50 million or more speakers carry Ethnologue's 2026 totals (the Ethnologue 200 list, read 2026-10-13); Mandarin's 1,183M is split Simplified 1,151M / Traditional 32M. Not on that list, so still the totals gathered 2026-09-21 (estimates dated 2019-2023): pa (113M, combined Punjabi), pl, uk, ro, ceb, zu, nmf. Totals are a plain sum, so a person who speaks two of our languages is counted in both; once the sum passes WORLD the page says the world is covered rather than quoting a larger number. rosterTotal is the same sum over the full 80-language roster. WORLD is world population: 8.30 billion at 1 July 2026, UN World Population Prospects 2024 revision. Added 2026-10-14 (Kevin '4 yes'): ml 38M (L1 37M + L2 0.8M, India 2011 census as cited by Wikipedia) and ig 31M (total speakers as cited by Wikipedia; Ethnologue's current figure not confirmed).
